title: Named-part customization
description: Apply local classes to the track, cards, controls and dots without replacing the built-in scroll-snap or focus states.

title: Plain application cards
description: Try 3 or 4 columns, then filter to one or two products. Cards keep their column width and centre when they fit; dots return when the track can scroll. This example also hides the arrows below 640px using showControlsOnMobile.
